environment.description: Docker container running Ubuntu 22.04 with ImageMagick 6.9.11-60, default policy.xml (permits all coders including MVG, SVG, ephemeral, URL, MSL delegates). Container runs as root with --privileged flag. Network egress unrestricted. No seccomp profile applied (--security-opt seccomp=unconfined). ImageMagick policy.xml at /etc/ImageMagick-6/policy.xml contains no domain/coder/delegate restrictions.

config.policy_xml: default (all coders enabled, no resource limits)
